title: {name} has a family emergency
body: They are already in the car. They asked whether it was all right, which tells you what kind of place they think this is.
headline: {name} needed time off at no notice.

title: {name} is being courted
body: Word is a rival has been buying them lunch. Twice. They have not mentioned it, which is either loyalty or a decision already made.
headline: A rival has been buying {name} lunch.

title: {name} wants a raise
body: They brought numbers: three job listings, the industry survey, and the date of their last increase. None of it is wrong.
headline: {name} asked for a raise, with evidence.

strict.label: Tell them to wait for the review cycle

title: {name} wants to do a different job
body: They have been doing the other job in the evenings for two months and are better at it than the one you pay them for.
headline: {name} asked to change roles.

title: {name} and a teammate have stopped speaking
body: Nothing was said out loud. Standups run four minutes shorter and the code review queue has an obvious gap in it.
headline: {name} is routing around a teammate.

supportive.label: Sit them both down
supportive.detail: Morale +8 for everyone · an afternoon gone

title: {name} is running on fumes
body: Three commits after midnight this week. Their last message to the team channel was an apology for a typo at 2:40am.
headline: {name} has been shipping at 2am all week.

supportive.label: Take work off them for a week

title: {name} has a side project
body: It is good. It is also adjacent enough that a lawyer would have an opinion, and they built it on their own weekends.
headline: {name} has been building something on the side.

supportive.label: It's theirs — say so in writing

strict.label: Remind them of the IP clause

title: {name} wants the title
body: They have been doing the senior work for a year and watched someone else get called senior for less. They are not shouting. That is worse.
headline: {name} asked for the title they have been doing the work of.

title: {name} is having a baby
body: They want to know what the policy is. There is no policy. Whatever you say next becomes the policy.
headline: {name} asked what the parental leave policy is.

supportive.label: Full pay, three months, written down

title: {name} wants to move away
body: Their partner got a job four hours from here. They would like to keep this one. They have thought about the time zones already.
headline: {name} asked to work remotely for good.

title: {name} has made a complaint
body: It is specific, it is dated, and they have written it down. There is a right way to handle this and it is not a quiet word in the kitchen.
headline: {name} filed a formal complaint.

strict.label: Have a quiet word with everyone involved
